entries.title: Proverbs 21:1
segments: ¶The king's heart [is] in the hand of the LORD, [Like] the rivers of water; He turns it wherever He wishes.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:2
segments: ¶Every way of a man [is] right in his own eyes, But the LORD weighs the hearts.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:3
segments: ¶To do righteousness and justice [Is] more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:4
segments: ¶A haughty look, a proud heart, [And] the plowing of the wicked [are] sin.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:5
segments: ¶The plans of the diligent [lead] surely to plenty, But [those of] everyone [who is] hasty, surely to poverty.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:6
segments: ¶Getting treasures by a lying tongue [Is] the fleeting fantasy of those who seek death.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:7
segments: ¶The violence of the wicked will destroy them, Because they refuse to do justice.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:8
segments: ¶The way of a guilty man [is] perverse; But [as for] the pure, his work [is] right.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:9
segments: ¶Better to dwell in a corner of a housetop, Than in a house shared with a contentious woman.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:10
segments: ¶The soul of the wicked desires evil; His neighbor finds no favor in his eyes.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:11
segments: ¶When the scoffer is punished, the simple is made wise; But when the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:12
segments: ¶The righteous [God] wisely considers the house of the wicked, Overthrowing the wicked for [their] wickedness.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:13
segments: ¶Whoever shuts his ears to the cry of the poor Will also cry himself and not be heard.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:14
segments: ¶A gift in secret pacifies anger, And a bribe behind the back, strong wrath.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:15
segments: ¶[It is] a joy for the just to do justice, But destruction [will come] to the workers of iniquity.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:16
segments: ¶A man who wanders from the way of understanding Will rest in the assembly of the dead.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:17
segments: ¶He who loves pleasure [will be] a poor man; He who loves wine and oil will not be rich.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:18
segments: ¶The wicked [shall be] a ransom for the righteous, And the unfaithful for the upright.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:19
segments: ¶Better to dwell in the wilderness, Than with a contentious and angry woman.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:20
segments: ¶[There is] desirable treasure, And oil in the dwelling of the wise, But a foolish man squanders it.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:21
segments: ¶He who follows righteousness and mercy Finds life, righteousness and honor.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:22
segments: ¶A wise [man] scales the city of the mighty, And brings down the trusted stronghold.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:23
segments: ¶Whoever guards his mouth and tongue Keeps his soul from troubles.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:24
segments: ¶A proud [and] haughty [man] -"Scoffer" [is] his name; He acts with arrogant pride.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:25
segments: ¶The desire of the lazy [man] kills him, For his hands refuse to labor.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:26
segments: He covets greedily all day long, But the righteous gives and does not spare.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:27
segments: ¶The sacrifice of the wicked [is] an abomination; How much more [when] he brings it with wicked intent!

entries.title: Proverbs 21:28
segments: ¶A false witness shall perish, But the man who hears [him] will speak endlessly.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:29
segments: ¶A wicked man hardens his face, But [as for] the upright, he establishes his way.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:30
segments: ¶[There is] no wisdom or understanding Or counsel against the LORD.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:31
segments: The horse [is] prepared for the day of battle, But deliverance [is] of the LORD.
